notes: Printed names: 'BROOKLINE AV.', 'MARION AV.', 'BISHOP', 'LORETTA' (no suffix printed; written 'Loretta Avenue' because the key map prints 'LORETTA' small and gives no suffix either - change to 'Loretta Street' if the convention for suffix-less names must hold), 'JEFFERSON AV.', 'CARTHAGE PIKE'. Two streets leave the east side of Carthage Pike toward the right edge with no name printed on this sheet; from the key map (km3) they are Bear Av (top, at y~905, toward 271's north side) and W. Shields (y~5520, the 270/271 boundary), written 'Bear Avenue' and 'West Shields Street' - check against 270/271. Bishop north of Jefferson (50 ft) comes down from Marion (Bishop continues north into Volume Six beyond Marion), curves, then angles SW to Jefferson; the 40 ft Bishop that runs south onto 267 leaves Jefferson ~95 px further SE (two T's, 'Bishop Street (north of Jefferson)' and 'Bishop Street'). Loretta (20 ft) runs SE from a dead end and opens into Bishop at its angle point. Jefferson Av is the diagonal from the Brookline bend to the Carthage Pike junction at the bottom (Carthage Pike branches NE from Jefferson's east side there; the same junction is on 267 at (3116,668)).
